items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And our piano player, George Clapham, he was the same way. The drummer, George Hines, -- they are all Georges... We had trombone. We had Jacob Patrick, trombone. One of the Syncopated Orchestra. And myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: And our piano player, George Clapham, he was the same way. The drummer, George Hines, -- they are all Georges. George Hines was a wonderful drummer, but not for dancing.
As a showman on the stage or to do a concert, to do tricks, to make people laugh, he was wonderful for that. But not to play tempo in a dance hall.
